cve_summary: pdf.c in ClamAV 0.97.1 through 0.97.7 allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (out-of-bounds-read) via a crafted length value in an encrypted PDF file.
docstring:

Summary: 
Handles the encryption settings of a PDF document by processing the encryption object.

Parameters: 
pdf (struct pdf_struct *): Pointer to the PDF structure containing encryption details.

Returns: 
None

Logic: 
The function first checks if the encryption object ID is valid and if the file ID exists. It retrieves the encryption object and its size, then reads various encryption parameters such as `/EncryptMetadata`, `/P`, `/R`, and `/Length`. It validates these parameters, ensuring they fall within acceptable ranges. The function also reads the `/O` and `/U` strings, checking their lengths and ensuring they meet specified criteria.
